subject: PO field checks, net terms and staggered invoice lanes
messages:
From: Priya Rao <priya@alphasecure.com>
To: chloe_martin@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 17 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: PO fields + invoice cadence for Redwood engagement

Hi Chloe,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — excited to move forward. Procurement asked me to send the PO plus some onboarding constraints so we can get Redwood set up in our ERP. Attached is PO #78934. A few important requirements from our side: 

- PO header must include Alphasecure entity code (AC-CA-02) and cost center (CC-UK-RD) on every invoice line.
- We need split invoices per legal entity/BU: 3 invoices per month (one per BU) tied back to the same PO number.
- Preferred net term is Net 30, but we'll confirm based on payment runs.
- Invoice PDF must show the PO number on each line item and include Redwood's tax ID.
- Please provide vendor onboarding packet (W9, vendor contact, vendor code suggestion) and cadence for the SOW.

Can you confirm whether Redwood can: 1) accept split/monthly invoices tied to a single PO, 2) include the additional PO metadata on the invoice line, and 3) provide an initial SOW that maps to the PO lines so our AP can match automatically?

Thanks,
Priya Rao
Sourcing Manager, Alphasecure Inc.
priya@alphasecure.com
Attachment: Alphasecure_PO_78934.pdf

From: Chloe Martin <chloe_martin@redwood.com>
To: Priya Rao <priya@alphasecure.com>
Cc: marcus_lin@redwood.com, vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 17 Jun 2026 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: PO fields + invoice cadence for Redwood engagement

Hi Priya — appreciate the clarity and the PO. Looping in Marcus from Finance and Vanessa on partnerships to confirm operational details.

Short answers up front: we can support split invoices tied to a single PO and include PO metadata on each invoice line, but a couple of clarifying questions will help us map this cleanly in our billing system:

1) When you say "3 invoices per month (one per BU)", do you mean a fixed schedule (e.g., 1st / 10th / 20th) or "up to 3" whenever amounts post?
2) We will need the exact ERP vendor code you want on the invoices — AC-CA-02 vs an alternate entity code affects which legal entity is billed.
3) For automated matching, can you share the exact invoice matching rules (PO on line, cost center field name, expected file naming)?

Next steps: Marcus — can you confirm any limitations on our side for producing 3 separate PDFs per PO on a monthly schedule and whether finance needs Net 30 vs Net 45 for a new enterprise account? Vanessa — once Marcus confirms, I can draft a short SOW that maps to the PO lines and share for Alphasecure review.

Thanks — I attached a draft SOW outline (Redwood_SOW_v1.docx) to speed up matching.

Best,
Chloe Martin
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
chloe_martin@redwood.com
Direct: +1 415-555-0123
Attachment: Redwood_SOW_v1.docx

From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
To: chloe_martin@redwood.com
Cc: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com, Priya Rao <priya@alphasecure.com>
Date: Wed, 17 Jun 2026 14:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: PO fields + invoice cadence for Redwood engagement

Chloe / Priya — quick finance note: we can produce multiple invoices tied to a single PO, but operationally we prefer a consistent monthly cutoff to avoid reconciliation friction (we typically support either: single consolidated invoice per month with line-level allocation, or up to 4 scheduled invoices tied to PO lines). Producing exactly three predictable runs is fine as long as you confirm the calendar dates.

Regarding terms: for a first-time enterprise vendor we usually request Net 45 until vendor onboarding completes (banking/KYC, tax docs). If Alphasecure can accept Net 45 for the first two billing cycles, we can move to Net 30 thereafter.

Required for onboarding (I'll attach vendor onboarding template separately to this thread):
- W9/Tax form or local equivalent
- Banking details for ACH or wire (we prefer ACH in USD)
- Vendor contact for AP and remit-to email
- Suggested vendor/ERP code to appear on invoices

If Alphasecure confirms the three monthly cutoff dates and sends back the ERP vendor code, finance will set up the billing schedule and we will issue a vendor setup form.

Regards,
Marcus Lin
Director, Revenue Operations
marcus_lin@redwood.com
Attachment: Redwood_vendor_onboarding_template.xlsx

From: Priya Rao <priya@alphasecure.com>

Thanks all — confirming acceptance (subject to internal approval):

- Alphasecure will accept three scheduled invoice runs per month tied to PO #78934 on the 1st, 11th, and 21st (local AP calendar).
- We can provide ERP vendor code: AC-CA-02 (please include on every invoice line).
- Alphasecure accepts Net 45 for the first two cycles, after which we will transition to Net 30.
- Attached is the signed PO and the AP contact (payments@alphasecure.com).

We reviewed the draft SOW and the mapping looks good — please finalize the SOW so our legal team can perform a quick cross-check.
